অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়

জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড।

(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ২৩ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২০ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৬ জুন, ২০১৩ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the government authority responsible for issuing this customs notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the administrative body governing this customs issuance.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: এস.আর.ও. নং- ১৬২-আইন/২০১৩/২৪৪৯/কাস্টমস।- Customs Act, 1969 (Act IV of 1969) এর section 219, উক্ত Act এর THIRD SCHEDULE এর item 17 এর সহিত পঠিতব্য, এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, Tourists Baggage (Import) Rules, 1981 এর নিম্নরূপ অধিকতর সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: This act provides the enabling power under Section 219, read with Item 17 of the Third Schedule, for the National Board of Revenue to issue or amend baggage rules.
The act serves as the foundational legal authority for the governance of baggage import procedures in Bangladesh.
Third Schedule: Item 17 of this schedule is read in conjunction with Section 219 of the Customs Act to provide the necessary legal backing for the modification of baggage rules.
National Board of Revenue: The board acts as the regulatory body authorized to amend existing baggage rules under the powers granted by the Customs Act.
Tourist Baggage (Import) Rules 1981: These rules are subject to further amendment by the National Board of Revenue under the legal authority specified in the Customs Act.

processed_clauses.resolved_text:
উপরি-উক্ত Rules এর rule 2 এর serial no. (xxvi) ও উহার এন্ট্রির পরিবর্তে নিম্নরূপ serial no. (xxvi) ও এন্ট্রি প্রতিস্থাপিত হইবে, যথা :-

"(xxvi) Two bottles of spirituous beverages weighing not more than 2 litres."

Rules: The existing provisions of the rules regarding duty-free baggage allowance for spirituous beverages are amended by this order.
Passenger Baggage Allowance: A passenger is permitted to import spirituous beverages duty-free, subject to a specific quantity limit defined by the volume and number of containers.
